claimLedger.claim: IUI injects prepared sperm into uterus; less invasive/cheaper than IVF but lower success per cycle; unsuitable for blocked tubes, severe endometriosis, low reserve, male factor
claimLedger.sourceSection: HFEA · Intrauterine insemination (IUI) · Publication date listed 11 March 2016; fetched this session
claimLedger.limitations: UK regulator information; NHS funding rules are not Indian practice rules

claimLedger.claim: IUI places sperm in womb at ovulation; unlikely to help blocked tubes, unexplained infertility, endometriosis, poor sperm; stimulation risks include multiples and OHSS
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Intrauterine insemination (IUI) · Page last reviewed: 25 June 2024
claimLedger.limitations: UK service eligibility; Indian clinic pathways differ
